verification.details: Unverified submission - no trajectory data available, unknown evaluation methodology, telecom domain omitted, incomplete evaluation (Pass^1 only)

entries.notes: Scores were achieved with a prompt addendum to both the Airline and Retail Agent Policy instructing Claude to better leverage its reasoning abilities while using extended thinking with tool use. The model is encouraged to write down its thoughts as it solves the problem distinct from our usual thinking mode, during the multi-turn trajectories to best leverage its reasoning abilities. To accommodate the additional steps Claude incurs by utilizing more thinking, the maximum number of steps (counted by model completions) was increased from 30 to 100 (most trajectories completed under 30 steps with only one trajectory reaching above 50 steps).

entries.name: cortex-0-1_principledmachines_2026-10-20

verification.details: Verified by Sierra on 2026-11-03: all 97 banking_knowledge tasks, 1 trial, run independently with the submitter's cortex_tau2.py client in --local mode at commit b7ea9074. Only agent calls went to the Cortex endpoint (cortex-0.1, reasoning_effort medium); the user simulator (gpt-5.2, reasoning_effort low) and all grading ran on Sierra's side with Sierra's keys. 71/97 passed (pass^1 73.20%); no infrastructure errors. Published scores and trajectories are from this run. The submitter's own 4-trial run reported 78.35% pass^1; pass^2-4 are omitted because the verified run has 1 trial. Caveats: knowledge-base retrieval runs on the Cortex server and is not visible in the trajectories (the submitter states the index contains only the banking_knowledge documents), and the hosted endpoint is not a frozen snapshot, so the result reflects cortex-0.1 as served on 2026-11-03. Cost is the submitter's reported average agent spend.

entries.notes: Cortex 0.1 is a cognitive architecture from Principled Machines. A cognitive core directs the work; a language model is one kind of compute it uses, for semantic judgement, and other parts of a task go to retrieval, programs and other specialized components. We attribute the result to two mechanisms: enhanced retrieval for multi-hop questions over the knowledge base, and process-calculus abstractions for the policy workflows. Submitted as custom because Cortex replaces the standard single-model scaffold. No task-specific fine-tuning, no prompt tuning against the grader, no post-training on labels, and no autoresearch loop. Cost is the average agent spend per trajectory, excluding the user simulator. Write-up: https://principledmachines.com/research/tau3-banking/
